university: EPFL – École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne

programme.title: Informatique (Bachelor) – EPFL
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Informatique), 3 years / 180 ECTS; first year shared with Communication Systems; autumn start
programme.how_found: epfl.ch -> Education -> Bachelor (/education/bachelor/) -> Programs -> Computer Science; twins from the page's hreflang alternates (en, fr, de, it).
programme.notes: Bachelor taught in French (B2 required, C1 recommended). Holders of a non-EU/EFTA/UK school certificate are not admitted to first year directly: they can be admitted, within available places, to the Cours de mathématiques spéciales (CMS, foundation year) or sit the entrance exam. First-year capacity limited to 3000 from 2025 for at least four years.

english.quote: EPFL considers that level B2 in French (according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages ) is required to follow its Bachelor’s programs
english.notes: French-taught bachelor; foreign applicants who did not study French in upper secondary school must attest their level on application. Not an English requirement.

value.value: general average at least 80% of the maximum grade; mathematics and physics final grades at least 80% of the maximum
value.scale: percent of the maximum grade of the national scale
value.description: Non-EU/EFTA/UK upper secondary certificate: admission to the Cours de mathématiques spéciales (foundation year), after evaluation and within available places, if general average and maths/physics grades are at least 80% of the maximum; otherwise entrance exam.

gpa.quote: the final grades in mathematics and physics are at least 80% of the maximum grade the general average is at least 80% of the maximum grade They may also register for our entrance exam
gpa.notes: Quote is from the section 'Upper secondary school certificates from a country that is not a member of EU, EFTA, nor UK' (the same 80% wording also appears for EU/EFTA certificates, which go directly to first year). For non-EU the threshold admits to the foundation year (CMS), not to first year. 'The criteria are valid for the ongoing year.'

deadline.quote: Applications can be submitted from mid-November to the 30th of April to start your studies at EPFL the following September
deadline.notes: Same deadline for all bachelor/CMS applicants incl. foreign certificates (form validated and paid by April 30; step-2 documents by July 10). The date is printed without a year; for the September 2027 start it is 30 April 2027. Application fee CHF 150 for foreign certificates.

value.academic_year: from the 2025 fall semester (no academic year stated)
value.population: foreign students who take up residence in Switzerland for study purposes

tuition.quote: only the CHF 730 semester tuition fee is tripled by this measure (it is thus raised to CHF 2190 per semester)
tuition.notes: Per semester; total semester invoice CHF 2240 for these students (2190 tuition + 25 AGEPoly + 16 sports + 9 social fund). Swiss nationals and foreigners resident in Switzerland for another reason pay CHF 730. Index adaptation every four years (first in 2029). Not multiplied out.

scholarship_exists.quote: EPFL social scholarship EPFL is dedicated to supporting students, in particular when their financial situation makes it difficult for them to complete their studies
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based, last-resort (subsidiarity) support awarded per academic year. No merit scholarship for incoming bachelor students was found (EPFL Excellence Fellowships are a Master's award).

scholarship_international.quote: I am an international student When can you apply for a scholarship? After completing at least one year at EPFL and as of the successful completion of the first-year cycle
scholarship_international.notes: International students are eligible only after a year at EPFL and the first-year cycle, and only after an unexpected change of situation; funding for the whole of studies must be secured before arrival. Not available to incoming international applicants.
